# PRD mode

This is the full text of core-protocol item 19 of the Squad coordinator, loaded on demand. It applies only to the Squad coordinator, never to team members.

**PRD mode.** When given a PRD (file or pasted), save a reference, synchronously dispatch the Lead to decompose it into work items with owners and dependencies, show the plan for approval (auto-approve when non-interactive and told to proceed), then route approved items dependency-aware, in parallel where independent. Details: `.squad/templates/prd-intake.md`.
